name: Audio-Visual Delay
mechanism:
This method detects audio-visual temporal misalignment to identify deepfakes, following Chugh et al. (2020):

1. **입술동작추출**: Lip landmark positions are tracked per frame, computing lip aperture (vertical opening), lip spread (horizontal width), and lip area. The temporal signal of these geometric features captures the visual component of speech articulation.

2. **오디오Envelope추출**: The speech audio amplitude envelope and energy contour are computed in corresponding time windows. Additionally, voice activity detection (VAD) segments identify speech vs. silence boundaries in the audio stream.

3. **Cross-상관분석**: The temporal cross-correlation between lip motion signals and audio energy is computed at multiple lag values. Authentic speech shows peak correlation at near-zero lag (within the natural audio-visual asynchrony tolerance of ~±50ms). Deepfakes may exhibit shifted peaks due to imprecise lip-sync in face-swap or lip-sync models.

4. **음소-LevelSynchronyCheck**: Specific phonemes with visually distinctive mouth shapes (visemes) — bilabials /p/, /b/, /m/ requiring lip closure, and open vowels /a/, /o/ requiring wide opening — are detected in audio and verified against corresponding visual frames. Temporal mismatches at these critical phonemes indicate manipulation per Mittal et al. (2020).

5. **DynamicSynchronization점수 산출**: The consistency of audio-visual synchrony is measured over time. Natural speech maintains stable synchrony throughout. Deepfake videos may show variable synchrony — good alignment in some segments but drifting in others — as the face generation model intermittently fails to track the audio signal accurately.
parameters:
분석 유형: sensor
미디어: 비디오
입력: Video frames extracted at key intervals
출력: 신뢰도 점수 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 중간~높음 — 70-88% 단독 정확도. Most effective when combined with other 비디오 forensic methods. Performance depends on 비디오 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 비디오 through audio-visual delay analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 비디오 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 비디오 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 비디오 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 비디오 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 비디오
